Set aside as data anomalies (2-week volume ≥ 6× baseline — typically a split, new listing, or buyout): MGRC.

Source: hawkeyecharts.com pattern API (Stage-2 Pocket Pivot, Episodic Pivot, Power Trend, 52-Week High Breakout, VCP + Vol Surge, Follow-Through Day), de-duplicated. Volume math is computed here from daily bars: weeks are 5-session blocks; a week is "elevated" when its average volume ≥ 1.5× the ~10-week baseline (the baseline sits before the lookback window); last-day pop = last session / prior 20. Charts show ~52 weeks (left) and ~70 sessions (right) as OHLC bars — green when the close ≥ the open, red otherwise; blue volume bars mark weeks/days ≥ 1.5× that baseline; dashed line is the pivot. Educational only — not financial advice.
